column1: # Spanish (es). Drafted 2026-11-05 and decided through the three-vendor debate (l10n/decisions/es/); ships as beta.

# percent_style has a no-break space (U+00A0) between the number and the sign, so a label can't wrap them apart. decimal_style is an example of the separators; four-digit numbers take no separator in text (1234,5).
